name: comp-269

frames.best_why: The card is shown largest, so the alert strip, both fields and the button are all legible at once.

tagline: A thin bordered row with a red warning circle and one line of error text.
summary: An inline error strip for forms: a rounded border around a small red circled exclamation and the words An error occurred. It never floats and has no close button.
appearance: Inside a dark sign-in card sits a full-width rounded rectangle with a thin border, holding a small ringed red exclamation mark and a short line of pale text. Below are an email row, a password row with a red edge, and a white button.
behaviour: Static: nothing moves or responds. The strip stays in place above the fields and cannot be dismissed.
demo_content: A sign-in card with "An error occurred!", alex@company.com, masked password dots and a Sign in button.
search_phrases: red warning message inside a form
small error strip with a red circle icon
inline message after a wrong password
form error text with a symbol
alert line above a login form
red outlined box with error text
use_when: A form needs a short, permanent error line next to the fields that caused it.
avoid_when: The message and its wording are fixed in the file, so varied or dismissible errors need editing.
customise: Only the border, padding and text classes are adjustable; the message itself is written into the file and there are no props.
weight_why: A border, a 16px icon and one line of text.

a11y.note: The icon is hidden from assistive tech, but the strip has no alert role, so an error appearing later is not announced.

issues: Without an alert role, screen readers will not announce the message when it appears.
polish_why: Plain but tidy alert row; no fill or accent beyond the red icon.
